feed.title: Open Tools and Research — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1321 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: dupehound: Find Copy-Pasted Code in Your Repo, Fast (Rust, Runs in Your Browser)
entry.summary: Drop a project folder and see every copy-pasted block: file, lines and the matching copy. A Rust copy-paste detector compiled to WebAssembly. Nothing is uploaded. Also a CLI that checked 9,458 files in 1.2 seconds.

entry.title: Shed Designer: Free Gable Shed Plans, 3D View and Lumber Cut List
entry.summary: Design a gable shed by dragging: get framing plans for the foundation, floor, four walls and roof, a 3D view, a lumber cut sheet using real 2x4 to 2x12 sizes and 8 to 16 ft boards, and a cost estimate. Free, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Agentic Trading Lab: backtest strategies, catch overfitting, paper trade first
entry.summary: Free, open-source research agent for trading your own account: backtests published momentum and trend rules on 100 years of US industry data and on BTC/ETH, charges for every strategy it tries (Deflated Sharpe, PBO), and only then lets you paper trade on Alpaca or trade crypto through Robinhood's official API.

entry.title: VSME Report Builder — Free Sustainability Report for Small Suppliers (Basic Module)
entry.summary: Free VSME Basic Module report builder for small EU suppliers asked for ESG data by customers or banks: fill in energy, emissions, workforce and safety figures, get a draft report, a completeness check and consistency flags. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Agent Workroom — A 3D Room for Your AI Agents' Tasks, by Voice or Text
entry.summary: Walk around a 3D room where each AI coding agent has a desk and every task sits on the wall. Add and move tasks by voice or text, and pull progress from a GitHub repo's pull requests. Free, runs in your browser.

entry.title: AI Bookkeeper: free double-entry books from your bank CSV, that learn
entry.summary: Free AI bookkeeping in your browser. Import bank and card CSVs, get an account suggested for every line with a reason, file the review queue once and it learns your payees. Transfers paired, trial balance, P&L, balance sheet, close checks, QuickBooks and Xero journals. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Open Floor Robots — build your own robot vacuum, robot mop or vacuum-mop combo (open source)
entry.summary: DIY robot vacuum, robot mop and robot vacuum-mop combo: open-source hardware (MIT) with laser-cut and 3D-printed parts, ESP32 firmware, a coverage path planner, and a cleaning simulator you can try in your browser on your own room.

entry.title: Free House Plan Generator: Parametric Home Designs to Download (CC0)
entry.summary: Generate a free house plan from a sentence: floor plan, elevations, 3D model (IFC, OBJ), CAD (DXF), bill of materials and a cost estimate. 1 to 5 bedrooms, farmhouse, craftsman, modern, ranch and cottage styles. Public domain, runs in your browser.

entry.title: Open Robot Mower — DIY robot lawn mower: open-source, wire-free RTK, full CAD
entry.summary: Build your own robot lawn mower. An open-source robotic mower with wire-free RTK GNSS navigation, a guarded pivoting-blade disc, a floating bump shell, ESP32 safety firmware and a complete CAD manufacturing package (MIT). Plan your own lawn's mowing pattern in the browser.

entry.title: Sales Agent — an AI sales inbox agent that sorts replies and drafts answers you approve, free
entry.summary: Free AI sales agent for the replies to your outreach. Paste them in: it spots unsubscribes, bounces, out-of-office and not-now replies, updates your list, and drafts answers to the interested ones for you to approve. Never sends anything.

entry.title: Support Agent — Self-Hosted AI Customer Service That Answers From Your Help Articles
entry.summary: An open-source AI support agent you host yourself: it answers customers from your own help articles, cites them, offers articles when unsure and hands off to a person on refunds, legal threats or anything it can't answer. Measured on BANKING77. Try it in your browser.

entry.title: Wall Framing Takeoff — stud layout, cut list and lumber order for a house
entry.summary: Free wall framing calculator for builders and framers. Enter walls, doors and windows; get the stud layout 16 or 24 on center, kings, jacks, headers and cripples, a cut list, plate splices over studs and the cheapest mix of board lengths to buy. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Changepoint Detector — find when a time series changed (PELT + Bayesian)
entry.summary: Free changepoint detection for any time series. Paste a CSV and see when the level or volatility changed, with exact PELT segmentation and Bayesian online changepoint probabilities (Adams & MacKay 2007; Killick et al. 2012). Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Conformal Prediction Intervals Calculator — distribution-free prediction intervals online
entry.summary: Free conformal prediction intervals calculator. Paste a CSV, pick the column to predict and a coverage level, and get distribution-free prediction intervals with a finite-sample guarantee: split conformal, locally weighted conformal and conformalized quantile regression (CQR), checked on held-out rows. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: CSV to SEPA Payment File (pain.001) — Free Bulk Credit Transfer Converter
entry.summary: Free CSV to SEPA converter: turn a spreadsheet of supplier or payroll payments into a pain.001 XML file for your bank's bulk upload. Checks every IBAN and amount first, writes exact control totals, and never uploads your list.

entry.title: CSV to SEPA Direct Debit File (pain.008) — Free Mandate Collection Converter
entry.summary: Free CSV to SEPA direct debit converter: turn a spreadsheet of member or customer collections into a pain.008 XML file for your bank. Checks every IBAN, mandate and your creditor identifier first, groups FRST/RCUR/OOFF/FNAL batches, and never uploads your list.

entry.title: Hearth & Horizon: free AI-written science fiction and Catholic bedtime stories, with audio
entry.summary: Free short science fiction about the next thousand years, stories written for AI agents, and Catholic bedtime stories about the saints. Read or listen; podcast RSS feeds; CC BY-SA 4.0.

entry.title: Interview to Content Calendar: Posts for Every Platform (Free)
entry.summary: Answer one guided interview about your brand or topic and get a 4-week content calendar with drafts for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, newsletters, blogs and more. Free, runs in your browser, optional AI on your own key.

entry.title: Matrix Profile Online — Find Repeated Patterns and Anomalies in a Time Series
entry.summary: Free matrix profile tool for time series anomaly detection and motif discovery. Paste or upload a CSV and find repeated patterns (motifs) and the most unusual stretches (discords) with the exact STOMP algorithm. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Personality Conversation Simulator: Fictional Characters (Free)
entry.summary: Build fictional characters with Big Five personalities and simulate negotiations, team meetings and arguments between them. Free, private, runs in your browser.
